name: dsh-web-search-bing
description: Free Bing-backed web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (ctx.web). Queries Bing's public HTML search page (cn.bing.com, reachable from mainland China), so web_search works with no API key and without consuming DeepSeek (or any LLM) search quota. Targets DSH 0.2.x (settings forms generated from the exported Config schema; no dsh-settings import).
